articles.title: The Dragon Under the Plaster
articles.text: An influential merchant paid workers to mend a cracked wall before the spring procession passed through the old district. The manual repair seemed routine until a rapid scrape of plaster revealed the painted eye of a dragon. For a fortnight, conservators worked in a light breeze, using photographs to draw the missing pattern without inventing detail. They finished just before the parade, and people slowed beneath the recovered mural instead of rushing past it.
articles.translation: 一位有影响力的商人出资，让工人在春季游行经过老城区前修补开裂墙面。手工修复看似普通，直到快速刮去一层灰泥后露出一只彩绘龙眼。接下来的两周，修复师在微风中工作，借助照片勾画缺失图案，不凭空添加细节。他们恰在游行前完工，人们在恢复的壁画下放慢脚步，不再匆匆走过。

articles.title: How Emergency Networks Recover
articles.text: An emergency network can attach a temporary antenna to a vehicle and furnish power from a portable battery. Teams first explore which towers remain possible to use, taking care not to disturb damaged structures or innocent residents nearby. A simple card may remind volunteers to carry an overcoat, spare cable, water, and the phone number of a relative such as a niece. Recovery becomes faster when equipment, people, and messages have several routes rather than one fragile centre.
articles.translation: 应急网络可以把临时天线装到车辆上，并由便携电池供电。团队先探查哪些通信塔还能使用，同时注意不扰动受损结构，也不打扰附近无辜居民。一张简单卡片可以提醒志愿者携带大衣、备用电缆、水，以及侄女等亲属的电话号码。设备、人员与消息拥有多条路线而非一个脆弱中心时，恢复会更快。

articles.title: Historic Streets Can Serve Daily Life
articles.text: Preserving a historic street becomes hard when officials relate every broken window to crime and every repair to tourism. Fortunately, a neighborhood is not a museum: a cousin may visit, children need leisure space, and residents carry extra shopping home. A gap between heritage rules and daily needs can decide the fate of a building by making ordinary maintenance impossible. Public faith grows when grants support safe wiring, accessible doors, and homes that remain affordable to the people who care for them.
articles.translation: 当官员把每扇破窗都与犯罪联系、把每次维修都与旅游挂钩时，保护历史街道就变得困难。幸运的是，社区不是博物馆：表亲会来访，孩子需要休闲空间，居民还要把额外采购带回家。遗产规定与日常需要之间的差距可能让普通维护无法进行，从而决定建筑命运。当补助支持安全布线、无障碍入口，以及让照料建筑的人仍负担得起住房时，公众信任才会增长。
